content: First attempt used `dotnet new xunit` (classic template). Failed real restore: NU1008, since Directory.Packages.props uses Central Package Management and only pins xunit.v3.mtp-v2, not classic xunit/Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk/coverlet.collector. Deleted and re-scaffolded with `dotnet new xunit3`, matching the centrally-pinned package. Second failure: template's own PackageReference still carried an explicit Version, which CPM forbids. Fixed by stripping the Version attribute in the .csproj (edit_block). Set TargetFramework to net11.0 to match the real OrchestratorService.csproj (was net8.0 by template default). Added ProjectReference to ../../src/services/ProjectName.OrchestratorService/ProjectName.OrchestratorService.csproj. Wrote TerminalCommandPolicyTests.cs: 4 Theory blocks, 31 InlineData cases total covering AutoReadOnly, AutoMutating, default-deny RequiresHil, and denylist-overrides-allowlist. Registered project via `dotnet sln pmcro-runtime.slnx add`. Ran `dotnet test` for real.
real_output: Test run summary: Passed! total: 31, failed: 0, succeeded: 31, skipped: 0, duration: 589ms. Zero build warnings after fixing an initial xUnit1026 unused-parameter warning.
